top_signals.title: Nvidia Partner Quanta Seeks Up to $2.2 Billion From Offering
top_signals.summary: Artificial-intelligence server maker Quanta Computer Inc. is seeking to raise as much as $2.19 billion from a sale of global depositary shares, in an offering that may be the biggest Taiwanese stock sale in 19 years.
